description: This is a test class for the 'StreamingSessionActor' component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines unit tests to verify the behavior of the actor, including termination conditions, acknowledgment handling, JWT validation, and subscription mechanisms.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for 'StreamingSessionActor', testing its behavior in different scenarios such as stream termination, acknowledgment handling, JWT validation failures, and message subscription.

methods.name: terminateOnStreamFailure
methods.description: Verifies that the actor terminates upon stream failure triggered by an exception.

methods.name: completeStreamWhenStopped
methods.description: Ensures that the stream completes properly when the actor receives a PoisonPill stop signal.

methods.name: terminateOnAckLabelDeclarationFailure
methods.description: Tests that the actor terminates if acknowledgment label declaration fails.

methods.name: sendDeclaredAckForGlobalDispatching
methods.description: Checks that acknowledged signals are correctly sent when acknowledgment labels are declared successfully.

methods.name: sendMalformedAck
methods.description: Tests handling of acknowledgments missing required correlation IDs, resulting in an exception.

methods.name: sendNonDeclaredAck
methods.description: Verifies behavior when an acknowledgment with an undeclared label is processed.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequestsAreRestrictedToDeclaredAcks
methods.description: Ensures that acknowledgments are only requested for labels that have been declared.

methods.name: invalidJwtClosesStream
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid JWT results in closing the streaming session.
